summary.notes: All 16 clips pass Guanacaste regional coherence (dry-tropical coastal ridges, golden sand bays, organic plaster/teak/stone architecture, zero conifers/snow/rainforest waterfalls). Note that pickup-feet-beach-path-01.mp4 contains an internal dissolve around 2.3s-3.1s between two distinct shots (bare feet on leaf trail -> wide ocean waves on cove shore).
